title: Understanding Convex Functions
text: Remember that for a convex function, the local minimum is also the global minimum. This means that if you find a point where the derivative is zero, it is likely the optimal point.

title: Exploring the Gradient
text: Consider the direction of the gradient at $${\theta_0}^0$$. If the gradient is positive, which direction should you move to decrease the function value?

title: Choosing the Optimal Direction
text: If the gradient at $${\theta_0}^0$$ is positive, should you move left or right to find the minimum?

title: Comparing Values
text: Think about how the value of $${\theta_0}^0$$ compares to the optimal value $$hat_{\theta,0}$$. If moving left decreases the function value, what does that say about the relationship between these two values?

title: Determining the Relationship
